extracted.name: Pickled Peppers
extracted.description: These homemade pickled peppers are simple to make with red bell peppers, vinegar, and sugar for a crunchy condiment or delicious snack.
ingredient_lines: 3 red bell peppers, halved, or more to taste
instruction_lines: Combine water, vinegar, sugar, and salt in a saucepan; bring to a boil. Add bell peppers to boiling water mixture. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer until peppers are softened, 8 to 10 minutes.
Transfer peppers and liquid to glass jars. Screw on the lids and refrigerate for 8 hours to overnight.
